import numpy as np

def multimodal_rag(query, index, llm, top_k=3):
    query_emb = clip_encode(query)
    # Search
    scores = query_emb @ index.embeddings.T
    top_k_idx = np.argsort(scores)[-top_k:][::-1]
    # Format context
    context = ""
    for idx in top_k_idx:
        item = index.items[idx]
        if item.type == 'text':
            context += f"Text: {item.content}\n"
        elif item.type == 'image':
            context += f"Image: {item.description}\n"
    # Generate
    prompt = f"Question: {query}\nContext:\n{context}\nAnswer:"
    response = llm.generate(prompt)
    return response
